description:
Make the dependency-feature policy tests fail rather than pass when they cannot run cargo.

## Background

`crates/jit/tests/scratch_build/dependency_feature_policy_tests.rs:168,185` print `SKIP: no cargo on PATH to resolve the dependency graph` and pass when `cargo tree` cannot run. Cargo passes its own path to test processes in the `CARGO` environment variable.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Both tests run `cargo tree` through the cargo that runs the suite and fail, naming the missing tool, when it cannot run.
- [hard] REQ-02: Neither test has a skip path.
title: Dependency-feature policy tests fail when cargo is missing
